name: Edwin Najmi Submission Attack System
description: Edwin Najmi’s Mission Submission covers darce setups, triangle entries and Estima-lock attacks from guard, top positions and takedown defense.
summary: Three submission families with entries from guard, top positions and takedown defense.
overview: Mission Submission brings together Edwin Najmi’s darce, triangle and Estima-lock attacks. Each family has its own section, with entries ranging from half guard and turtle to spider and lasso guard. The appeal is a selection of distinct attacks across positions, rather than a complete offense built around one hold.

related_content.name: Danaher Armbar System
related_content.relationship: Arm Bars: Enter The System offers an eight-volume examination of one submission family, with extensive control and hand-separation material.

products.title: Mission Submission

products.best_for: Grapplers seeking several distinct submission options, including gi-guard attacks.

guide.display_title: Edwin Najmi: Darces, Triangles and Estima Locks

fits: You want a course covering darces, triangles and Estima locks together.
You are interested in both upper-body attacks and gi-guard leg attacks.
consider_alternative_if: You want every entry to be independent of gi grips.

includes: Darce entries from side control, half guard, turtle and single-leg defense.
Triangle attacks from closed guard, knee shield and spider guard, plus inverted and flying variations.
Estima locks involving leg drags, lasso and De La Riva guard.
limits: The three parts cover these specific submission families, not a complete submission or positional-control curriculum.

sources.title: Mission Submission by Edwin Najmi
sources.note: Edwin Najmi and Mission Submission verified. Three-volume contents establish darce, triangle and Estima-lock tracks, including spider-guard entries; no grip mechanics or flying-entry instruction reviewed.
